description: A versioned research release containing 18 specialist papers, one scientific atlas, individual submission packages, data, verification code, theorem and correction ledgers, and source archives. Release 8.0.2 preserves the academic-source separation completed in 8.0.1 and corrects Git-canonical checksums, publication metadata, and clean-clone verification. The formal prime-observer theorem remains fully typeset and supported by formal diagrams, tables, code, and data.
title: Distinction, Perspective, and Predictive Closure: Complete Research Release 8.0.2
